Urban Development
Lackawanna County Building
Scranton, Pennsylvania 18503
Dear Mr. Traussi:
This is in response to your request for the Department of the Interior's comments on six draft environmental statements concerning urban renewal projects in Pennsylvania. They are:
1. Penn-Susquehanna Urban Renewal Project, Harrisburg, Dauhpin County, Pennsylvania
2. Model Cities One Urban Renewal Project, Reading, Berks County, Pennsylvania
3. Kingston Urban Renewal Project, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania
4. Downtown Urban Renewal Project, Wilkes-Barre, Luzern County, Pennsylvania
5. Lock Haven Urban Renewal Project, Clinton County, Pennsylvania
6. Urban Renewal Project, Boroughs of Milton and Turbot, Pennsylvania
We are combining our comments on all six statements because of the similar nature of the projects and because our interests are essentially the same with regard to each.
Each of the statements should contain specific evidence of coordination with the Pennsylvania Historical and Museum Commission regarding project impacts on sites of historical significance. Each should also indicate, pursuant to Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act of 1966
